topic.readerProblem: Founders and marketers want their pages cited in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode and need to know what Google actually requires, which advice is folklore, and how to measure whether it is working.
topic.connection: Google AI Overviews are one of the AI answer surfaces AEOeye audits; the guide explains how citation works there and where a brand-level AEOeye audit differs from page-level Search Console reporting.

assessment: The rewritten guide answers how to get cited in Google AI Overviews from Google's own current documentation (the AI optimization guide updated 2026-07-10, the AI features page and Search Console's Generative AI performance report) instead of third-party folklore. It rests on Google documentation, Pew Research, BrightEdge and two Ahrefs studies with their caveats stated, adds AEOeye's crawler access study for the Google-Extended point, and deliberately does not claim controlled AI Overview experiments, ideal passage lengths or any guaranteed outcome.

sources.supports: Eligibility (indexed and snippet-eligible), 'still SEO', non-commodity content weighted above the guide's other tips, the myths list (llms.txt, chunking, AI-only writing, inauthentic mentions, structured data), the query fan-out definition and lawn example, the scaled content abuse warning and that indexing and serving are not guaranteed; page last updated 2026-07-10.

No additional requirements or special optimizations; fan-out wording for both AI Overviews and AI Mode; a wider and more diverse set of links than classic search; nosnippet, data-nosnippet, max-snippet and noindex as controls; AI feature traffic reported in the Performance report's Web search type; Google-Extended pointer; page last updated 2025-12-10.

Generative AI performance report: impressions as the described metric (no mention of clicks, CTR or position), AI Overviews and AI Mode covered, rolled out to all websites worldwide as of 2026-08-31, subject to receiving enough impressions.
nosnippet also prevents content being used as direct input for AI Overviews and AI Mode; max-snippet limits how much may be used (page updated 2026-03-24).
Google-Extended does not impact a site's inclusion in Google Search and is not a ranking signal; it has no separate HTTP user agent string (page updated 2026-07-14).
The URL Inspection tool reports whether Google has indexed a page and offers live tests.
Passage ranking and freshness systems are listed as active Google ranking systems (page updated 2025-12-10).
E-E-A-T is not itself a specific ranking factor, trust is the most important element, and fabricating creator profiles is a form of deception (page updated 2026-10-01).
Do not repeatedly update dates without substantial content changes.
March 2025 browsing data from 900 U.S. adults: users clicked a link inside an AI summary in 1% of visits; Wikipedia, YouTube and Reddit were 15% of the sources in AI summaries.

Ahrefs, 2026-03-02, 863K keyword SERPs and 4M AI Overview URLs: 37.9% of cited URLs ranked top 10, 31.2% ranked 11 to 100, 31.0% beyond 100, versus about 76% in July 2025; Ahrefs attributes the shift to sources appearing in fan-out query SERPs.
Search Engine Journal (2026-03-02) reports Ahrefs improved its parsing methodology since July 2025, so the two datasets are not directly comparable.

BrightEdge, 2025-09-18, nine industries: 54.5% of AI Overview citations ranked organically versus 32.3% in May 2024, only 16.7% from top-10 results, healthcare 75.3% versus e-commerce 22.9%; the page states no sample size and does not define the rank cutoff.
Ahrefs, 2025-11-11: over 43,000 keywords tracked for a month, a 70% chance an AI Overview changed between observations and 54.5% URL overlap between consecutive responses.

GEO paper (KDD 2024): quotation addition, statistics addition and cite-sources raised visibility in its tests while keyword stuffing lowered it; Google AI Overviews was not evaluated (confirmed in the arXiv HTML full text).
Profound's own site names Google AI Overviews among the AI platforms it targets; not tested hands-on by AEOeye.
Otterly.AI's own site names Google AI Overviews among the platforms it monitors; not tested hands-on by AEOeye.

Search Console's Search generative AI control excludes a site from AI Overviews, AI Mode and Discover generative features, isn't a ranking signal for other parts of Search, and rolled out to all websites on August 31, 2026.
